mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a Waning Gibbous moon visible. The International Space Station will be visible overhead starting at 5:07 AM, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and traveling toward the east-northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city has two important reminders. First, alternate-side winter parking regulations begin November 20 and run through April 1, requiring residents to park on specific sides of the street based on the calendar date. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can enjoy Main Street Trick-Or-Treat at Hometown Junction Park or live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Dane County Farmers' Market takes place tomorrow at the Capitol Square, and there is more live music scheduled at Paddy Mac's tomorrow as well.

In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for over 20 minutes, leading to an arrest for O W I.
Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you. While today's flavor of the day is currently unknown, we look forward to welcoming you back for a delicious treat.
